fact: In 2024 Burkina Faso received 120.3 billion FCFA of migrant remittances from other UEMOA countries (Côte d'Ivoire 23.6% of total, Mali 6.3%) and sent 102.0 billion FCFA to Union countries, 90.2% of its total remittances sent.
title: Balance des paiements et position extérieure globale 2024 du Burkina Faso - Rapport annuel
